title: The AI Behind Your Feed: Personalization, Moderation, and the Future of Social Media
description: AI shapes social media through recommendations, moderation, ad targeting, privacy trade-offs, and platform incentives most users never see.
short_description: A clear look at recommendations, moderation, privacy, platform incentives, and why your feed knows more than feels comfortable.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A clear, no-hype briefing on AI in social media for journalists, editors, platform teams, and readers tracking information systems.
